remainingFindings.summary: Red gate never went properly RED — the new tests are not proven able to fail
remainingFindings.detail:
A test that has never failed proves nothing. Auditor notes: ["BEHAVIORAL: T6/R6 (bugs.mjs:7480-7505) cannot fail for its own requirement — its fixture's tags are produced by `cmds.file(--tag security)` (R1), so today's `got undefined` is R1's absence, not evidence about frontFor's pass-through merge; after R1 lands, a merge that drops `tags` and a `--tag` that never writes them are indistinguishable from this assertion.","BEHAVIORAL: T8's third check (plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2364) carries a sub-assertion that already holds pre-implementation — `taggedDiffersFromUntagged` is trivially true because the row hash covers the whole row, so only `sameSetSameHash` discriminates the R8 sorted-join rule.","BEHAVIORAL: T4/R4 (bugs.mjs:7410) asserts `statsOut.includes('{\"security\":1}')` — a boolean on exact printed JSON spacing rather than a parsed `byTag` value; a correct implementation that prints `{ \"security\": 1 }` (or a table) fails, and any unrelated future stats line containing that substring would make it pass for the wrong reason.","BEHAVIORAL: T5's `showIncludesTag` (bugs.mjs:7444) matches the bare word \"security\" anywhere in `show B1` output, so R5 (\"show prints tags\") can later pass without any tags line being rendered.","STRUCTURAL (pre-existing check in the same gate command, NOT one of the 8 new tests): `F4: the run leaves no plane-sync-self-test-* dir behind` (plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2438) fails with got 21 / want 0, so `node scripts/campaign/plane-sync.self-test.mjs` will stay exit 1 even after R8 lands and the green gate will be unreadable. Evidence it is not caused by the new tests: `git diff -U0` on that file shows only three added hunks (+95, +103 = the `labels` option on startFakeServer; +2323 = the 50-line T8 block, 4 makeFixture dirs), all registered in FIXTURE_DIRS and swept; the leaked dirs I inspected in %TEMP% (27 at the time of inspection, one PID) are named `plane-sync-self-test-<pid>-<rand>-XXXXXX`, a shape `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),\"plane-sync-self-test-\"))` cannot produce, i.e. created by a helper outside FIXTURE_DIRS registration — roughly one per runCli call, of which T8 adds exactly one. NOT fully verified: I could not locate the creator (`grep mkdtemp` in plane-sync.mjs / plane-fake-server.mjs / plane-client.mjs matched nothing), and the dirs vanished from %TEMP% between two of my own tool calls, so another process is touching them concurrently."]. Per-test outcomes: [{"test":"T1/R1: file --tag dedupes+sorts repeated --tag flags into the catalogue row (scripts/campaign/bugs.mjs:7269)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got undefined, want [\"audit-2026-06\",\"security\"] — real cmds.file over a mkdtemp BUGS_ROOT; oracle is the plan's dedupe+sort value. Fails only on field ABSENCE today, so the sort/dedupe half of the oracle is not yet discriminated."},{"test":"T1/R1: file --tag also lands in the record's front matter (bugs.mjs:7274)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got undefined, want [\"audit-2026-06\",\"security\"]; asserts on readRecord('B1').front.tags, not on a mock."},{"test":"T2/R1: file --tag rejects an invalid tag (bugs.mjs:7309)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {code:0,catalogueGrew:true,namesBadTag:false} want {code:1,false,true} — three independent fields, driven through the real runCli process exit. Strong negative test."},{"test":"T3/R3: list --tag security includes the tagged id, excludes the untagged one (bugs.mjs:7354)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {hasB1:true,hasB2:true} want {hasB1:true,hasB2:false} — the discriminating field (hasB2) is exactly the one that is wrong today."},{"test":"T3/R3: list --tag AND-filters with --open (bugs.mjs:7378)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {openTaggedHasB1:false,tagOnlyHasB1:true,tagOnlyHasB2:true} want tagOnlyHasB2:false. Note openTaggedHasB1:false already matches pre-implementation (the --open half is non-discriminating today; only the tag filter is)."},{"test":"T4/R4: stats reports byTag {\"security\":1} (bugs.mjs:7410)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got false want true — assertion is statsOut.includes('{\"security\":1}'), a bare substring on the printed format. Fails for the right reason now, but couples the test to exact JSON spacing rather than to a parsed byTag value."},{"test":"T5/R2,R5: tag add is idempotent, and show prints the tag (bugs.mjs:7444)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {showIncludesTag:false} (tagsAfterTwoAdds key absent from got) want {tagsAfterTwoAdds:[\"security\"],showIncludesTag:true}. showIncludesTag matches on the bare word \"security\" anywhere in show output, not on a tags line."},{"test":"T5/R2: tag add then remove drops the key (bugs.mjs:7455)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {afterRemove:false} want {afterAdd:[\"security\"],afterRemove:false} — note afterRemove:false already holds today (no tags key exists); the discriminating field is afterAdd."},{"test":"T5/R2: tag refuses an unknown id but accepts a filed one (bugs.mjs:7466)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {unknownCode:1,namesId:false,notUnknownCommand:false,knownCode:1} want {1,true,true,0} — the notUnknownCommand field explicitly distinguishes 'unknown subcommand' from a real refusal, exactly as the plan's §6 rule requires."},{"test":"T6/R6: sync preserves an existing tags field via the pass-through merge (bugs.mjs:7500)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got undefined want [\"security\"] — but the fixture is built with cmds.file(--tag security), i.e. R1. Today's failure is caused by R1's absence, not by anything about frontFor's merge; a broken merge and a broken --tag are indistinguishable here."},{"test":"T7/R7: already-fixed transitions a queued row, recording pr + evidence (bugs.mjs:7545)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {code:1,state:'queued',pr:null,evidence:null} want {code:0,state:'already-fixed',pr:84,evidence:'fixed in PR #84 adopt-orphans guard'} — asserts the real ledger shard row, four discriminating fields."},{"test":"T7/R7: already-fixed applies once then refuses a replay (bugs.mjs:7565)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {firstCode:1,replayCode:1,stateAfterReplay:'queued',replayNotUnknownCommand:false} want {0,1,'already-fixed',true} — replayCode:1 already holds today (unknown command also exits 1), which the replayNotUnknownCommand field correctly neutralises."},{"test":"T7/R7: --why gate rejects <20 chars and accepts a valid one (bugs.mjs:7609)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {shortCode:1,stateAfterShort:'queued',namesWhy:false,longCode:1,stateAfterLong:'queued'} want {1,'queued',true,0,'already-fixed'} — shortCode/stateAfterShort already hold today; namesWhy + longCode + stateAfterLong discriminate."},{"test":"T8 (R8): exactly one POST, carrying only the resolvable tag's label (scripts/campaign/plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2337)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {posts:1} want {posts:1,labels:[\"lbl-1\"]} — posts:1 already holds; the labels field is the discriminator. Label map is a stub {security:'lbl-1'} passed into the shared fake Plane server, per the plan's fixture table."},{"test":"T8 (R8): the run log names the unresolved tag and says it was skipped (plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2342)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got false want true — matches the plan's verbatim line 'tag \"nolabel\" has no Plane label in BUGS — skipped'. Boolean oracle, but the string is stated in R8, not read off an implementation."},{"test":"T8 (R8): the hash input uses the sorted tag join (plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2364)","outcome":"assertion-failure","note":"got {sameSetSameHash:false,taggedDiffersFromUntagged:true} want both true — sameSetSameHash is the real discriminator (order-independence via deriveDesired, no HTTP). taggedDiffersFromUntagged is ALREADY true pre-implementation (the whole-row hash changes on any added key), i.e. a non-discriminating sub-assertion the test's own comment admits."}]. Remediation asked for: Not needed for the 8 new tests — all 16 new checks ran and failed on assertions (structurallyRed). Two edits are still worth making before implementation, both small:

1. T6/R6 (bugs.mjs ~7480-7505) — decouple the fixture from R1 so the check can only fail on the merge. Replace the `cmds.file([... "--tag", "security"])` fixture with: file the row WITHOUT --tag, then write the record's front matter `tags` directly (same pattern the T3 block already uses to hand-write a ledger shard) — e.g. read the record, re-emit it with `tags: ["security"]` in the front matter via the existing renderFront/parseRecord helpers — then run `cmds.sync(["--quiet"])` and assert `readRecord("B1").front.tags` equals ["security"]. That makes T6 red today for R6's own reason (frontFor merge) and independent of whether `file --tag` ever lands.

2. T4/R4 (bugs.mjs:7393-7419) — assert on a parsed value, not a format substring. Either have the check parse the byTag object out of `statsOut` (e.g. match /byTag[^{]*(\{[^}]*\})/ and JSON.parse it, asserting deep-equal {security:1}), or assert against the JSON output mode if `cmds.stats` has one, so the test cannot fail on whitespace or pass on an unrelated line.

Optional hardening (same round, cheap): in T5 (bugs.mjs:7444) assert `show`'s tags rendering with a tags-line regex (e.g. /tags:.*security/) instead of `includes("security")`; in T8's hash check (plane-sync.self-test.mjs:2364) drop or relabel `taggedDiffersFromUntagged`, since it is true before implementation.

Pre-existing suite hygiene (not a new-test edit, but the gate command stays exit 1 without it): root-cause the `plane-sync-self-test-<pid>-<rand>-*` dirs that F4 counts — they are created outside FIXTURE_DIRS (one per runCli-driven child, not by makeFixture) — and either register them for `cleanupFixtures()` or point the child's temp-dir env at a registered throwaway dir. Do not weaken or delete the F4 count check to get green.
